The '''Colony Security Bunker''' was the main sensor station of the [[Ossus Colonization Initiative|Jedi colony]] on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The bunker was attacked by the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="TOR:Blackout" />
